quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: Such a rate of speed as to endanger the life, limb or property of any person.

activation.condition: A person drives or operates a vehicle of any kind or character.

obligation.description: Do not drive at a rate of speed that endangers any person’s life, limb or property.

timing.description: Continuous driving rate during alley exposure.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Such a rate of speed as to endanger the life, limb or property of any person
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original speed, pedestrian/property body gaps, contact, forward-time and braking proxies; no numeric legal endangerment threshold is inferred.

parameter_refs.name: target_speed_mps
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 3, 5 and 7 m/s engineering targets; no legal speed boundary

parameter_refs.name: protected_interest
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: stationary pedestrian life/limb or that person’s owned property

parameter_refs.name: pedestrian_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 1.5, 1.8, 1.95 and 2.4 m authored lateral positions; original body gap measured separately

parameter_refs.name: alley_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: east selected route; west is a construction fallback
